title: Joshua Commissioned Before Israel
reflectionText: Moses responded to the end of his own leadership by asking God to provide a shepherd for the congregation. Joshua’s commission happened openly, with responsibility and authority clearly entrusted to him. How can preparing another person well become an act of faithful care for everyone who will depend on that person?
editorialNotes: Packet 021 initial writer output. Short-only plan. The retelling stays within Numbers 27:12-23 and preserves Moses’s request, Joshua’s public commission, Eleazar’s role, and the congregation’s ordered leadership.
